request:
镜头 s39：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持，从她背后慢慢绕到侧面。宋念抱着笔记本站在竖井栏杆边，黑暗里，管道和窗口上一盏一盏亮起小小的绿灯，越来越多，连成一片。她长出了一口气。环境声：竖井里的风声、远处此起彼伏的提示音。
情绪：hopeful, vast, quietly triumphant
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium wide shot, slow handheld arc from behind her to her side
景深与虚实：Nian sharp in the foreground, the green lights soft bokeh points in the depth.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Raw verité shot from behind and to the side: Nian stands at a railing over the dark vertical shaft of the underground city, the notebook held against her chest; across the darkness, small green lights are winking on one by one along the pipes and windows, linking up. Blocking lock: Nian stands at the railing at frame left seen from behind, the dark shaft fills the right two thirds where the green lights appear.
Picture 2: Nian (Song's daughter, dispatch engineer, 33 in 2075, 36 in 2078) (character reference; role: the daughter, now grown up). A Chinese woman in her mid-thirties, dispatch engineer of an underground city: straight black shoulder-length hair tucked behind her ears with short side-swept bangs, calm guarded tired eyes, faint lines, a round face grown lean. Dark grey dispatcher uniform jacket with a high collar, a light headset around her neck.
Picture 3: the underground city main street (location reference; role: location reference). Wide shot of the main street of a huge underground city five kilometres below the surface: stacked steel habitation modules on both sides, exposed pipes and cable trays overhead, steam vents, food stalls with warm bulbs, crowds of ordinary people in padded work clothes, puddles on the concrete floor, haze in the air.
Picture 4: Song's notebook with the crayon drawing taped on the first page (prop reference; role: prop reference). A worn hardback engineer's notebook lying open: on the first page the child's crayon drawing (a big black box with one red eye and many small smiling coloured boxes holding hands) is taped in with yellowed tape; around it and across the facing page, an adult's dense pencil diagrams of networks, many small circles linked by lines, arrows and loops spreading outward. Only abstract shapes, no legible words or numbers.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：wind in the shaft, scattered soft electronic chimes far away
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/move/documentary-handheld] move
[ours/cam-arc] 运镜：绕到侧面
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[ours/cam-verite-follow] 机位：纪实手持跟拍
[rules/move/handheld-slight] move
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

16:9 horizontal, single clip 10.0s, 24fps, Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, medium wide shot, shoulder-mounted handheld camera with one slow, slightly unsteady arc that starts directly behind Nian and drifts round to her left side, ending as a medium shot on her profile; the operator reacts a beat late, the framing settling after the lights have already begun to appear. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at the start: Nian at frame left seen from behind in three-quarter back view, both hands on the notebook pressed to her chest, the railing rail running from lower frame left toward frame centre, the dark shaft filling the right two thirds of the frame with the first sparse green points in the mid-depth right. Start: she stands still at the railing, breathing visible in the cold, the wind lifting the hair at her nape, the notebook held tight enough to crease her thumb against the board. Middle: the camera eases round her shoulder; as her back clears the frame edge, one green telltale flickers on far right, then another further down a pipe, then a run of them along a window frame, each one a small hard point in the haze; her head turns a few degrees to follow them and her grip on the notebook loosens. End: the lights have linked into one soft field across the shaft; she exhales a long breath that drops her shoulders, her profile now fully in frame, eyes moving across the green, mouth easing, the notebook settling flat against her chest. Mood: hopeful, vast, quietly triumphant. Blur: Nian's hair, cheek and the notebook sharp in the foreground; the green lights rendered as soft bokeh points in the depth, the far pipes and cable trays dissolving into black haze. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.
